purpose: Verify that a static demo can be opened independently on a mobile browser.

proven.claim: The demo renders correctly in the local test environment.

assumed: The hosting path is reachable from the target network.

failed.attempt: Open the temporary artifact URL from an external browser.
failed.result: The URL was blocked before the application loaded.

current_blocker: No independently reachable public URL has been verified.
decisive_uncertainty: Whether the deployment path, rather than the application itself, is the cause of external access failure.

next_test.action: Serve the unchanged static bundle from one public static host and open it from a separate network.
next_test.pass_condition: The target page loads and the interaction completes without privileged access.
next_test.fail_condition: The page remains unreachable or the interaction fails before completion.
